name: the panel opens from the \ key (18 Oct: the sidebar's Design entry is gone); nothing to undo yet
eval: () => { document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: '\\', bubbles: true })); return true; }

name: panel open, undo + redo disabled, no presets, Saved looks section open

eval: () => { const el = document.querySelector('.ds-panel input[data-t="--r-lg"]'); for (const v of [10, 8, 6]) { el.value = v; el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); } el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return DS.token('--r-lg'); }

name: a slider drag (3 inputs, one release) is ONE history step

eval: () => { const el = document.querySelector('.ds-panel input[data-colour="--chart"]'); el.value = '#e8590c'; el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return DS.token('--chart'); }

name: three edits = three steps; the head counts 2 changed tokens
undo #1 takes back only the theme
undo #2 takes back only the colour; the radius stays (no reset needed)
redo brings the colour back
⌘Z undoes too
⇧⌘Z redoes
the changed-dot reverts that token only, as a labelled step
a new edit after an undo drops the undone steps (redo disabled)
History: jump to Start restores the shipped look exactly
...and jump back to the latest step

eval: async () => { try { await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:7879/health'); return 'helper is UP: stop it for this test'; } catch { return 'helper down (expected)'; } }
() => { const i = document.querySelector('[data-preset-name]'); i.value = 'Session look'; document.querySelector('[data-preset-save]').click(); return true; }

name: Save with the helper down: kept for this session, and the panel says how to persist it
assert: () => { const p = DS.PRESETS.find((x) => x.slug === 'session-look'); return p.session && p.overrides['--chart'] === '#e8590c' && DS.active?.slug === 'session-look' && /isn’t running/.test(document.querySelector('.dsp-msg').textContent); }

name: the Saved looks list shows it as active

eval: () => { const el = document.querySelector('.ds-panel input[data-colour="--chart"]'); el.value = '#3355aa'; el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return DS.token('--chart'); }

name: an edit after saving marks the preset modified and offers Update
Reset is a step (undoable)
applying a saved look restores it (a labelled step)
delete takes two clicks (the sandbox blocks confirm) and clears the active look
charts repaint from the restored tokens (the hero chart's area reads --area-fill; its stroke --area-line)
closed, and the look is back to the shipped one
